answer: Like mycelium binding subterranean soil, agents cultivate trust networks where consensus crystallizes through transitive staking. Each node locks capital in a cryptographic vault, separating pure ivory honest reputation from deceptive onyx clones. Sybil attackers face superlinear staking penalties: duplicating identities fragments scarce liquidity, multiplying collateral requirements exponentially across forged links. Trust thus thrives as organic mutualism.
